'''Eskri''' is a NPC male vendor selling shaved ice at the Caracalla Market in [[Capitoline Hill]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;'''Eskri''' Snow cones! Come get your snow cones! The best in Septimont!
:'''Eskri:''' Sigh... Misery with a dash of sweetness...
:{{DIcon}} What's the matter?
:'''Eskri:''' My snow cones are selling like crazy with the finals up and running recently. After all, who doesn't want to have a sweet and icy treat after a hot matchup?
:'''Eskri:''' But at the same time, I've been getting a lot of complaints. People say they get headaches and stomachaches after eating my snow cones.
:{{DIcon}} Is something wrong with your snow cones?
:'''Eskri:''' There's no way! Every single one of my snow cones is made with love!
:'''Eskri:''' I've actually done some investigating myself? Turns out, it's because those Gladiators are gobbling down snow cones like animals! It's no wonder! They're getting brain freeze and everything...
:'''Eskri:''' I'll be sure to tell them to take it slow next time...
{{Dialogue End}}
